_comment: Seat = worker + model. quality 1..5 per category (missing = cannot do it). Calibrated 2026-11-18 from public benchmarks (aa_index = Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 via benchlm.ai, display-only; Arena text for prose) plus the maintainer's own tests ('tested' lists categories verified in practice; re-test on your setup). Ratings (bin/route.py rate) adjust scores after enough samples. cost: relative quota burn 1..4. pool: which quota is spent.

categories.review: review code or text, find bugs, judge quality
categories.vision: understand images/screenshots in the workdir (describe, extract, check UI)
categories.image_gen: generate image files (art, icons, covers, concept art)
categories.game_code: gameplay logic, game systems, UI code (HTML/JS canvas, Phaser, Unity C#, Godot)
categories.game_visual: in-engine visuals: sprites, tilemaps, shaders, 2D/3D animation setup, scene layout (hardest category for AI)
categories.blender: 3D assets/scenes/animation via Blender Python scripts, rendered with ai-snap
categories.animation: code-based animation/video: canvas/CSS/SVG, Manim, Remotion; render to frames to check
categories.video_gen: generate short video clips (5-10 s, text- or image-to-video); expensive, ask the user first

in_house._comment: Work Claude keeps (never dispatched); checked before any seat. claude-opus = this session if it runs Opus, else an Agent subagent with model opus.

rules.why: design/architecture/plans drive all later work; Opus writes it from scratch; workers only supply facts (research). Weak-draft + strong-review lands below strong-alone (arXiv 2610.15897)

agy-claude-gpt._note: small weekly quota: agy (Google) Claude/GPT group, not Claude Code; 7 Opus/Sonnet runs took it from ~62% to 27% weekly on 2026-11-18

seats._note: VideoGen (Kling): 5 s 960x960 24fps mp4 in ~150 s; ~50-100 credits per 5 s clip (tool's own estimate); 'AI生成' watermark top-left
